name: jediway
description: One pipeline for coding agents: brainstorm a spec, then Planner, Implementer, Verifier, one after another. The main session only orchestrates. Any language, any stack.

interface.shortDescription: Brainstorm, plan, implement, verify. One pipeline, no detours.
interface.longDescription: jediway gives a coding agent one way of working, and only one. The main session brainstorms the task with you, writes a short spec, and then dispatches three children in a fixed order: a Planner that grounds the repo and writes a cited plan, an Implementer that executes the whole plan and runs the acceptance criteria, and a Verifier that reproduces the evidence and has the last word. The orchestrator never reads the repository, never verifies, and never splits the task.
defaultPrompt: /jedi add rate limiting to the login endpoint
